title: Vistas Esmeralda | KEY.co
description_expanded: The house and location is excellent! The house is basically brand new, with super nice furnishings. Location is about a 3 minute walk across the road and down to lower cul-de-sac for beach access which is not bad at all. The only issue we had all week is on the beach , the rental company for the chairs will take up the entire front town and force you to rent or sit in second row. This is not right on a private beach. They set up chairs that nobody was in just to try and rent them each day. So they need to get the beach chair rental company either a designated area and only allow them to set up on certain parts due to blocking other guest. Inside, the open-concept design flows seamlessly between airy living spaces and a chef’s kitchen complete with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and a thoughtfully stocked coffee bar. Each bedroom offers a private sanctuary, including a bunk room perfect for younger guests and a top-floor king suite with its own Gulf-view balcony. Guests can unwind at the community pool, grill dinner al fresco, or hop on one of the four complimentary bikes to explore the charm of 30A. With a perfect balance of elegance and ease, Vistas Esmeralda promises unforgettable coastal moments in every season.
